phase: Development observed; before held-out original layout/text access
reason: PDFium ink boxes omit glyph side bearings; pdfminer spans use font advances. Comparing the two under the original 1.2 pt horizontal tolerance mislabeled correctly extracted original digits as missed.
policy: Keep original ink coordinates and targets byte-for-byte. Derive PDFium loose=True font boxes from the same original glyph indices. Compare both published baseline and current reader to those font boxes with the same 1.2 pt horizontal and vertical-midpoint policy. Use this fixed method before held-out inspection.
scope: Geometry measurement correction, not a product improvement. No target added, removed, or moved to a different original token.
baseline_harness_failure: The initial published-baseline attempt aborted on an eLife PDF page-edge limit. The complete baseline now records whole-document refusal as unknown; the incomplete attempt is not a complete score.
